judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across tool rounds using an `accumulateUsage` helper (placed in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` rather than inline in `chatOrchestrator.ts`) and adds thorough unit and acceptance tests covering multi-round sums and missing-usage rounds. It also properly updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. However, it misses the acceptance criterion requiring the hook signature/type to unambiguously state that it is a sum: despite checking off the facet in its own `.lore/dod.md`, the candidate never renames the `usage` parameter to `totalUsage` in `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` (or in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`) and even leaves the local variable in `chatOrchestrator.ts` named `lastUsage`. It also leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the diff and places the new orchestrator tests in a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than extending `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` as the reference does.
